events.detail_full_zh: 07:33左右，受东京Metro有乐町线内救援活动影响，部分列车出现晚点或停运。
events.detail_full_en: Around 07:33, some trains on the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line are experiencing delays or service suspension due to rescue operations within the line.
